name: pere-guerra-eclipse
description: Skills from processing the total solar eclipse of 12 August 2026, by Pere Guerra.

plugins.name: agentic-eclipse-library
plugins.description: Eclipse corona processing skills: first steps with your own photos (English); calibration and stacking, post-processing, artefact repair (Catalan); structure images, unrolled views and coronal motion with the ael package, and checks against coronagraphs (K-Cor, SOHO/LASCO, SDO/AIA) in structure and in mean solar brightness (English); a whole case to an editable master the photographer accepts, contributed by Raúl Hussein (English).
